tasks.title: Grammar
tasks.instructions: Read the following sentences. Choose the best answer for each gap. /12 x 1 = 12 points/

questions.stem: We'll meet ___ the entrance of the cinema ___ half past six.
questions.explanation: Барилгын орц гэх мэт тодорхой цэгийн өмнө (“the entrance of the cinema”) болон цагийн өмнө (“half past six”) “at” угтвар үг ордог тул “at / at”.

questions.stem: My sister ___ to work by bike every day.
questions.explanation: “every day” нь өдөр бүрийн зуршлыг заадаг тул одоо энгийн цаг; эгч (“My sister”) ганц тоо, гуравдугаар бие тул “go” нь “-es” авч “goes” болно.

questions.stem: Yesterday I ___ my keys, so I couldn't get into the house.
questions.explanation: “Yesterday” гэж өнгөрсөн тодорхой цагийг заасан тул “lose”-ийн өнгөрсөн энгийн цагийн хэлбэр “lost” орно; үр дүнд нь “I couldn't get into the house” гэжээ.

questions.stem: I ___ never ___ such a beautiful sunset.
questions.explanation: Амьдралын туршлагыг “never”-тэй одоо төгссөн цагаар илэрхийлдэг: “have” + III хэлбэр, тиймээс “have / seen” (ийм үзэсгэлэнтэй нар жаргахыг хэзээ ч харж байгаагүй).

questions.stem: Are you ___ anything this weekend? Would you like ___ shopping with me?
questions.explanation: “this weekend” гэсэн ойрын төлөвлөгөөг одоо үргэлжилж буй цагаар асуудаг тул эхний зайд “doing” орно; “Would you like”-ийн дараа инфинитив шаардлагатай тул “doing / to go” (“to go shopping”).

questions.stem: Is this the restaurant ___ you had your birthday party?
questions.explanation: “the restaurant” нь газар бөгөөд төрсөн өдрийн үдэшлэг тэнд болсон (“you had your birthday party”) тул газар заадаг харьцангуй төлөөний үг “where” орно; “which” хэрэглэвэл төгсгөлд нь “at” нэмэх шаардлагатай.

questions.stem: My grandfather ___ swim very well when he was young.
questions.explanation: Өвөө залуу байхдаа (“when he was young”) сайн сэлдэг байсан нь өнгөрсөн үеийн чадвар тул “could swim” гэнэ; “can” нь одоогийн чадвар, “should”, “must” нь зөвлөгөө, үүрэг илэрхийлнэ.

questions.stem: The teacher told us ___ quiet.
questions.explanation: “tell” үйл үгээр тушаал, хүсэлтийг дамжуулахдаа хүний дараа “to” + үйл үг ордог тул “told us to be quiet” (чимээгүй бай гэж хэлсэн) болно.

questions.stem: The new bridge ___ next year.
questions.explanation: Гүүрийг хүмүүс барина, гүүр өөрөө юу ч барихгүй тул үйлдэгдэх хэв хэрэгтэй; “next year” нь ирээдүйг заадаг тул ирээдүй энгийн цагийн үйлдэгдэх хэв “will be built” орно.

questions.stem: My brother is ___ than me at maths.
questions.explanation: “than me” нь харьцуулах зэрэг шаардана; “good at” (…-д сайн) нь харьцуулахдаа “better at” болох ба “much” нь ялгаа их болохыг онцолдог тул “much better”; “well” бол дайвар үг.

questions.stem: If you ___ me your number, I ___ you tonight.
questions.explanation: Нөхцөл хэсэгт ирээдүйн утгатай ч “will” ордоггүй, одоо энгийн цаг (“give”) хэрэглэдэг бөгөөд үр дүнд “will call” орно; энэ бол 1-р төрлийн нөхцөлт өгүүлбэр: “give / will call”.

questions.stem: My friend asked me what time ___.
questions.explanation: Шууд бус асуултад “what time”-ийн дараа өгүүлэгдэхүүн (“the train”) үйл үгийн өмнө орж, “asked” өнгөрсөн цагт байгаа тул “the train left” болно; “does the train leave” нь шууд асуултын дараалал.

tasks.title: Task 1
tasks.instructions: Read the sentences and choose the best one for each blank. /6 x 2 = 12 points/

questions.stem: She wants a long and successful ___ as a doctor.
questions.explanation: Эмчээр урт удаан, амжилттай ажиллах замналыг “a long and successful career” гэдэг; “job”, “work” нь тухайн ажил, “task” нь даалгавар тул энэ хоршоонд тохирохгүй.

questions.stem: You can always ___ on Batbayar; he never breaks a promise.
questions.explanation: “depend on somebody” нь хэн нэгэнд найдах, итгэх гэсэн утгатай; “he never breaks a promise” (амлалтаа хэзээ ч зөрчдөггүй) учир Батбаярт үргэлж найдаж болно.

questions.stem: Tourists can take a boat ___ around the lake.
questions.explanation: Нуурыг тойрон завиар зугаалахыг “a boat trip” гэдэг бөгөөд “take a trip” түгээмэл хоршоо; “travel” нь ерөнхий үйл үг, “traffic” замын хөдөлгөөн, “transport” тээвэр.

questions.stem: He was ___ about the interview, so he couldn't sleep the night before.
questions.explanation: “he couldn't sleep the night before” (өмнөх шөнө нь унтаж чадаагүй) нь ярилцлагаас өмнө “nervous” (сандарсан, түгшсэн) байсныг харуулна; “relaxed”, “calm” эсрэг утгатай.

questions.stem: The volcano ___ and covered the village in ash.
questions.explanation: Галт уул “erupted” (дэлбэрсэн) бөгөөд “covered the village in ash” (тосгоныг үнсээр бүрхсэн) нь дэлбэрэлтийн үр дагавар; “flooded”, “froze”, “melted” галт ууланд тохирохгүй.

questions.stem: I ___ you to wear a warm coat. It's minus thirty outside!
questions.explanation: Энд үйл үг хэрэгтэй: “advise somebody to do something” (зөвлөх); “advice” нь ижил утгатай боловч нэр үг тул өгүүлэгдэхүүний дараа үйл үгийн байранд орохгүй.

tasks.title: Task 2
tasks.instructions: Choose the one that has the similar meaning to the underlined word. /3 x 2 = 6 points/

questions.stem: The children were <u>delighted</u> with their new puppy.
questions.explanation: Шинэ гөлөгтэй болсон хүүхдүүд “delighted” буюу маш их баярласан тул ойролцоо утгатай нь “very happy”; “angry”, “scared”, “bored” сөрөг мэдрэмжийг илэрхийлнэ.

questions.stem: The hotel room was <u>spacious</u> and clean.
questions.explanation: “spacious” (өргөн уудам, зайтай) өрөөг “roomy” гэж бас хэлдэг; “small” нь эсрэг утгатай, “expensive”, “noisy” нь огт өөр шинж.

questions.stem: Please <u>reply</u> to my email as soon as possible.
questions.explanation: Имэйлд “reply” гэдэг нь хариу бичих гэсэн утгатай тул “answer”; “forward” нь өөр хүнд дамжуулах, “delete” устгах, “send” илгээх.

tasks.title: Task 3
tasks.instructions: Phrasal verbs. Choose the correct particles. /4 x 2 = 8 points/

questions.stem: Let's eat ___ tonight. I don't feel like cooking.
questions.explanation: “I don't feel like cooking” (хоол хийх дургүй байна) гэсэн тул гадуур, ресторанд хооллохыг санал болгож байна: “eat out”; эсрэг утга нь “eat in” (гэртээ хооллох).

questions.stem: Could you turn ___ the music? I'm trying to sleep.
questions.explanation: “I'm trying to sleep” гэсэн нь хөгжмийн дууг багасгахыг хүсэж байгааг харуулна: “turn down” (дууг намсгах); “turn up” нь эсрэгээрээ чангалах.

questions.stem: We have to hand ___ our essays by Friday.
questions.explanation: Эссэ, даалгаврыг багшид өгөхийг “hand in” (хүлээлгэн өгөх) гэдэг; “by Friday” нь өгөх эцсийн хугацааг заана.

questions.stem: The plane took ___ two hours late.
questions.explanation: Онгоц газраас хөөрөхийг “take off” гэдэг: “two hours late” гэж онгоц хоёр цаг хоцорч хөөрсөн гэж байна.

tasks.title: Task 4
tasks.instructions: Choose the best answer. /2 x 2 = 4 points/

questions.stem: ___ is someone who repairs water pipes, taps and toilets.
questions.explanation: Усны хоолой, цорго, бие засах газрыг засдаг хүн бол “A plumber” (сантехникч); “An electrician” цахилгаанчин, “A carpenter” мужаан, “A mechanic” машин засварчин.

questions.stem: ___ is someone who looks after people's teeth.
questions.explanation: Хүмүүсийн шүдийг эмчилж, арчилдаг хүнийг “A dentist” (шүдний эмч) гэнэ; “A vet” малын эмч, “A pharmacist” эм зүйч, “A surgeon” мэс засалч.

tasks.title: Communication
tasks.instructions: Choose the correct question that goes with the answers. /5 x 2 = 10 points/

questions.stem: Her mother. They're both kind and patient.
questions.explanation: Хариулт “Her mother” гэж хүнийг нэрлээд “They're both kind and patient” гэж ижил зан чанарыг дурдсан тул “Who does she take after?” (хэн рүүгээ татсан бэ) гэсэн асуулт.

questions.stem: On the third floor, next to the lift.

options.E: How do you get to work?

questions.explanation: “On the third floor, next to the lift” нь байршлыг заадаг тул “Where is your office?” гэсэн асуулт; “When does the office open?” цаг, “How big …?” хэмжээ асууна.

questions.stem: I'd like a cup of tea, please.

options.E: What would you like to drink?

questions.explanation: “I'd like a cup of tea” гэсэн хариулт “would like” бүтцийг давтаж ундаа сонгосон тул “What would you like to drink?” гэсэн санал болголтод тохирно; “Do you like tea?” гэвэл “Yes, I do” гэж хариулна.

questions.stem: Very well, thank you. And you?
questions.explanation: “Very well, thank you. And you?” нь “How are you?” гэсэн мэндчилгээний сонгодог хариулт; “Who are you?”, “How old are you?” гэж асуусан бол хэн болох эсвэл хэдэн настайгаа хэлэх байсан.

questions.stem: Glass, so be careful.
questions.explanation: “Glass” (шил) гэж материалыг нэрлээд “so be careful” (хагарч болзошгүй) гэсэн тул “What is it made of?” гэж юугаар хийснийг нь асуусан.

tasks.title: Reading
tasks.instructions: Read the article and choose the best answer for the questions. /8 x 2 = 16 points/
tasks.passageTitle: Journey to the Bottom of the Sea
tasks.text:
The Mariana Trench in the western Pacific Ocean is the deepest place on Earth. At its lowest point, called the Challenger Deep, the seabed lies almost 11,000 metres below the surface. If Mount Everest were placed inside the trench, its peak would still be about two kilometres under water.

Conditions at the bottom are extreme. There is no sunlight at all, the water is close to freezing, and the pressure is more than a thousand times greater than at the surface. For many years, scientists believed that nothing could survive there.

In 1960, two men, Jacques Piccard and Don Walsh, decided to find out. They climbed into a special vessel called the Trieste, which had very thick steel walls and tiny windows. The journey down took almost five hours. When they finally reached the bottom, they stayed for only about twenty minutes, because a crack had appeared in one of the windows. They reported seeing a flat, fish-like creature on the seabed, although some scientists today doubt this.

For more than fifty years, nobody returned to the Challenger Deep. Then, in 2012, the film director James Cameron made the dive alone in a submarine he had helped to design. He spent about three hours exploring the bottom and filmed what he saw. Since then, several more expeditions have followed, and scientists have found tiny shrimp-like animals and other creatures living at great depths.

Unfortunately, explorers have also found something less welcome: plastic. In 2019, an explorer saw a plastic bag lying on the seabed nearly 11 kilometres down. For many people, **this** was a shocking sign that human pollution has reached even the most remote places on our planet.

questions.stem: According to the text, the Challenger Deep

options.E: is the deepest part of the Mariana Trench.

questions.explanation: 1-р догол мөрөнд “At its lowest point, called the Challenger Deep” гэж бичсэн нь Челленджерийн гүн бол Марианы хонхрын хамгийн гүн хэсэг гэсэн үг; “two kilometres” нь Эверестийн оргилын дээрх усны гүнийг заана.

questions.stem: Before 1960, many scientists believed that

options.A: no living thing could survive at the bottom.
options.B: many fish lived at the bottom.
options.C: the trench was not very deep.
options.E: people had already reached the bottom.

questions.explanation: 2-р догол мөрөнд “For many years, scientists believed that nothing could survive there” гэжээ; “nothing could survive” нь ямар ч амьд зүйл амьд үлдэж чадахгүй гэсэн утгатай.

questions.stem: During the 1960 dive,

options.A: the explorers stayed at the bottom for five hours.
options.C: the explorers found a plastic bag.
options.D: a crack appeared in one of the windows.

questions.explanation: 3-р догол мөрөнд тэд ёроолд “only about twenty minutes” байсныг “because a crack had appeared in one of the windows” гэж тайлбарласан; таван цаг бол доош шумбахад зарцуулсан хугацаа.

questions.stem: Between 1960 and 2012,

options.A: many explorers visited the Challenger Deep.
options.C: nobody went back to the Challenger Deep.

questions.explanation: 4-р догол мөр “For more than fifty years, nobody returned to the Challenger Deep” гэж эхэлдэг; 1960 оноос 2012 он хүртэл тэнд хэн ч дахин очоогүй.

questions.stem: James Cameron

options.A: went down alone in a submarine he had helped to design.
options.C: spent twenty minutes at the bottom.

questions.explanation: Жеймс Камерон 2012 онд “made the dive alone in a submarine he had helped to design” гэж бичсэн; тэр Жак Пиккартай хамт биш, ганцаараа шумбасан.

questions.stem: What does "this" in the last paragraph refer to?

options.D: finding a plastic bag at the bottom

questions.explanation: Өмнөх өгүүлбэрт судлаач “saw a plastic bag lying on the seabed nearly 11 kilometres down” гэж бичсэн тул “this was a shocking sign” дахь “this” нь далайн ёроолоос гялгар уут олдсон явдлыг заана.

questions.stem: What have scientists found living at great depths since 2012?
questions.explanation: 4-р догол мөрөнд 2012 оноос хойш “scientists have found tiny shrimp-like animals and other creatures living at great depths” гэжээ; энэ нь сам хорхой шиг жижиг амьтад.

questions.stem: The writer mentions the plastic bag to show that

options.B: the trench is easy to reach.
options.C: pollution has reached even the deepest ocean.

questions.explanation: Зохиогч гялгар уутыг “a shocking sign that human pollution has reached even the most remote places on our planet” гэж дүгнэсэн нь бохирдол далайн хамгийн гүнд ч хүрснийг харуулах зорилготой.

tasks.instructions: Match the beginnings of the sentences (a-e) with the appropriate endings (1-6). There is one extra ending in column 2. /5 x 1 = 5 points/

items.label: a
items.explanation: Ургамлыг усалдаггүй бол хатаж үхдэг нь байгалийн жам; ийм байнгын үр дүнг “If you don't water plants, … they die” гэж нөхцөл, үр дүн хоёуланд нь одоо энгийн цагаар илэрхийлнэ (0 төрлийн нөхцөлт өгүүлбэр).

items.label: b
items.text: If I lived by the sea, …
items.explanation: Далайн эрэгт амьдардаггүй хүн төсөөлж байгаа тул “If I lived by the sea” гэж өнгөрсөн цаг хэрэглэсэн бөгөөд үр дүнгийн хэсэгт “would” зохицоно: “… I would go swimming every day”.

items.label: c
items.explanation: “in case” (…байж магадгүй тул) нь урьдчилан сэргийлэх шалтгааныг заадаг бөгөөд араас нь одоо энгийн цаг ордог: “Take an umbrella in case … it rains later”.

items.label: d
items.explanation: “Do you know …” гэсний дараах асуулт дотор туслах үйл үг “does” хэрэглэхгүй, өгүүлэгдэхүүн үйл үгийн өмнө орно: “… what time the shop closes?”; “what time does the shop close?” асуултын дараалалтай тул тохирохгүй.

items.label: e
items.explanation: Ирээдүйг заасан “when” холбоос үгийн араас “will” биш, одоо энгийн цаг ордог: “I'll buy a new phone … when I get my first salary” (анхны цалингаа авахаараа).

choices.text: … I would go swimming every day.
… when I get my first salary.
… what time does the shop close?

tasks.instructions: Choose an appropriate answer for each question. There is one extra answer in column 2. /5 x 1 = 5 points/

items.label: a
items.explanation: “Could you pass the salt, please?” гэж ширээн дээрээс давс дамжуулахыг хүсэхэд өгөхдөө “Here you are.” (май, аваарай) гэж хэлдэг.

items.label: b
items.explanation: “Where were you born?” нь төрсөн газрыг асуудаг тул газар заасан “In a small town in the Gobi.” гэсэн хариулт тохирно; “At seven o'clock.” нь цаг заана.

items.label: c
items.explanation: “What's the matter?” (юу болов, яасан бэ) гэж санаа зовж асуухад асуудлаа хэлж “I've got a terrible headache.” (толгой маш их өвдөж байна) гэж хариулна.

items.label: d
items.text: 'Would you like to come to my party?'
items.explanation: “Would you like to come to my party?” гэсэн урилгыг баяртай хүлээн авахдаа “I'd love to.” (дуртайяа очно) гэж хэлдэг.

items.label: e
items.explanation: “How long does the film last?” нь киноны үргэлжлэх хугацааг асуудаг тул “About two hours.” (хоёр цаг орчим) гэсэн хариулт тохирно.

choices.text: 'In a small town in the Gobi.'

tasks.instructions: Read the text and fill in the gaps (a-e) with the appropriate adjectives (1-6). There is one extra adjective. /5 x 1 = 5 points/
tasks.text:
1. honest   2. ambitious   3. confident   4. lazy   5. generous   6. nervous

Some experts say that a handshake tells you a lot about a person. People with a firm, strong handshake are usually a) _________; they believe in themselves and are not afraid to speak in public. A weak handshake can mean the person is b) _________ and worried about meeting new people.

People who look you in the eye while shaking hands are often c) _________; they don't hide the truth. Those who shake with both hands are thought to be d) _________ and kind; they like giving gifts and helping others. Finally, people who shake hands quickly and then move on are often e) _________. They have big plans and want to get to the top.

items.label: a
items.explanation: Хатуу, бат гар барьдаг хүмүүс “believe in themselves and are not afraid to speak in public” гэсэн нь “confident” (өөртөө итгэлтэй) гэсэн үгийн тайлбар.

items.label: b
items.explanation: “and worried about meeting new people” гэж санаа зовнилтой хамт дурдсан тул сул гар барилт “nervous” (сандарсан, түгшүүртэй) хүнийг илтгэнэ.

items.label: c
items.explanation: Гар барихдаа нүд рүү хардаг хүмүүс “don't hide the truth” буюу үнэнийг нуудаггүй тул “honest” (шударга).

items.label: d
items.explanation: “and kind; they like giving gifts and helping others” гэсэн нь бэлэг өгч, бусдад туслах дуртай “generous” (өгөөмөр) хүний шинж.

items.label: e
items.explanation: “They have big plans and want to get to the top” (том төлөвлөгөөтэй, оргилд хүрэхийг хүсдэг) нь “ambitious” (эрмэлзэлтэй, амбицтай) гэсэн утга; “lazy” аль ч зайд тохирохгүй.

tasks.instructions: Read the following report about cinema attendance. Then choose the correct ending for each sentence. There is one extra ending in column 2. /5 x 1 = 5 points/
tasks.text:
Cinema attendance in Northland

In 2010, about 30 million cinema tickets were sold in Northland. By 2020 this number had fallen to 18 million, mainly because more people watched films at home on streaming services.

Experts expect the decline to continue more slowly. They predict that ticket sales will drop to around 15 million by 2030. However, the picture is different for young people. The number of visitors aged 15 to 24 is expected to rise slightly, because many cinemas now offer cheap student tickets and special 3D and IMAX screens.

Cinemas are also changing what they sell. By 2030, almost half of their income is expected to come from food and drinks rather than tickets.

items.label: a
items.explanation: 2010 онд 30 сая тасалбар зарагдсан бол 2020 онд “this number had fallen to 18 million” гэсэн тул 12 саяар буурсан: “… fell by 12 million”.

items.label: b
items.text: The main reason for the fall …
items.explanation: Буурсан шалтгааныг “mainly because more people watched films at home on streaming services” гэж заасан тул “… was the popularity of streaming at home”.

items.label: c
items.explanation: “are expected”-ийн дараа инфинитив орох ёстой бөгөөд тайланд “ticket sales will drop to around 15 million by 2030” гэжээ: “… to drop to around 15 million”.

items.label: d
items.explanation: 15–24 насны үзэгчдийн тоо “is expected to rise slightly” гэсэн бөгөөд “rise slightly” нь бага зэрэг өсөх гэсэн утгатай тул “… is expected to increase a little”.

items.label: e
items.text: By 2030, almost half of cinemas' income …
items.explanation: Тайлангийн сүүлд “almost half of their income is expected to come from food and drinks rather than tickets” гэсэн тул “… will come from food and drinks”; 3D дэлгэц нь харин залуучуудыг татах арга.

choices.text: … is expected to increase a little.
… will come from food and drinks.
… was the popularity of streaming at home.

tasks.title: Listening
tasks.instructions: You are going to listen to a dialogue between a radio presenter and a woman scientist who spent a year in Antarctica. For questions 41-46 decide which of the choices A, B, C, D or E is the correct answer. You have 45 seconds to look through the questions before you listen. You will listen twice only, so listen carefully. /6 x 2 = 12 points/
tasks.audioScript:
Presenter: My guest today is Dr. Helen Moore, a scientist who has just come back from a year at a research station in Antarctica. Welcome home, Helen!
Helen: Thank you. It's wonderful to see trees again!
Presenter: How many people were at the station?
Helen: In summer there are about eighty, but in winter only fourteen of us stayed. From April to October no planes can land, so we were completely alone.
Presenter: What was your research about?
Helen: I study penguins, emperor penguins in particular. I was counting the birds and measuring how the melting sea ice affects their chicks.
Presenter: What was the hardest part?
Helen: The darkness. For about three months the sun doesn't rise at all. Some people find it very depressing. We kept a strict routine, with meals at the same time and exercise every day, and that really helped.
Presenter: Was it ever dangerous?
Helen: Once, in July, our generator broke down during a storm, and the temperature inside started to drop quickly. Our engineer, Mark, worked for six hours in the cold to fix it. Everybody else stayed together in one room to keep warm. We were lucky to have him.
Presenter: Would you go back?
Helen: Definitely, but maybe next time only for the summer!

questions.stem: In winter, ___ people stayed at the station.
questions.explanation: Хелен “in winter only fourteen of us stayed” гэж хэлсэн; “about eighty” нь зуны үеийн хүний тоо тул өвөл “fourteen” хүн үлдсэн.

questions.stem: Helen's research was about
questions.explanation: Хелен “I study penguins, emperor penguins in particular” гэж хэлээд “how the melting sea ice affects their chicks” хэмжиж байсан гэсэн тул судалгаа нь эзэн хаан оцон шувуу ба далайн мөсний тухай.

questions.stem: Between April and October,

options.A: planes cannot land at the station.

questions.explanation: Хелен “From April to October no planes can land, so we were completely alone” гэж хэлсэн тул энэ хугацаанд станцад онгоц буух боломжгүй.

questions.stem: According to Helen, the hardest part was
questions.explanation: Хамгийн хэцүү зүйлийн тухай асуухад Хелен “The darkness. For about three months the sun doesn't rise at all” гэж хариулсан тул “the long darkness” (удаан үргэлжилсэн харанхуй).

questions.stem: When the generator broke down,

options.B: the engineer repaired it while the others kept warm together.

questions.explanation: Генератор эвдрэхэд “Our engineer, Mark, worked for six hours in the cold to fix it. Everybody else stayed together in one room to keep warm” гэжээ: инженер Марк засаж, бусад нь нэг өрөөнд дулаацсан.

questions.stem: Helen would like to

options.E: go back, perhaps only for the summer.

questions.explanation: “Would you go back?” гэсэн асуултад Хелен “Definitely, but maybe next time only for the summer!” гэж хариулсан тул дахин очихыг хүсэж байгаа ч магадгүй зөвхөн зунаар.
